title: Meta addresses ‘pervert glasses’ reputation with a privacy fix and a new marketing campaign
summary: Meta is updating its smart glasses to close a loophole that allowed recording with the LED indicator covered. The camera will now stop working completely if the light is covered during recording, addressing privacy concerns about the device.
content:
Meta is updating its AI-powered smart glasses to close a loophole that allowed wearers to keep recording after covering the front-facing LED. Alex Himel, Meta's vice president of augmented reality, writes in a post on Threads that "the camera will now stop working if the light is covered during a recording."
The company's line of smart glasses already disables their built-in cameras if someone covers the LED capture light, which blinks to alert others that you're recording or taking a picture. However, some wearers found that they can bypass these restrictions by covering the LED light after they started recording. This latest fix comes a l …
Read the full story at The Verge.

title: GTA VI: all the news on Rockstar’s next entry in the Grand Theft Auto series
summary: Grand Theft Auto VI's release has been delayed to November 19, 2026. A new 'extended look' debuted on Netflix showing protagonists Jason and Lucia in Vice City with significantly improved graphics and detailed environments.
content:
It’s been over a decade and two console generations since GTA V came out, and its sequel is still a work in progress. GTA VI has faced multiple delays, with developer Rockstar Games bumping back its predicted release date twice, eventually shifting to November 19th, 2026, a full year after its originally planned fall 2025 release window. Early official glimpses offered a look at the game’s protagonists, Jason and Lucia, who players will navigate around Vice City as outlaws on the run after a job goes south.
Preorders have opened for the digital code-only game, offering the $79.99 standard edition and $99.99 Ultimate Edition on both PS5 and Xbox Series X / S.
Rockstar Games has also responded to “CyberLeek” posts that showed sequences of the game, calling them heartbreaking and saying, “…this is obviously not how we intended for you to see the game after all this time.” At about the same time, the leakers released yet another clip.
Now a half-hour “extended look” has arrived full of gameplay slices and cutscenes that’s available for viewing on Netflix, as well as all over other social media channels in reaction videos before it hits YouTube at 9PM — here are some of our first impressions.
Read on below for all of the news and updates about Grand Theft Auto VI.

title: Google’s AI note-taking app now allows you to interact with books
summary: Google's Gemini Notebook now integrates Google Play Books content, allowing users to ask questions and generate recipes, infographics, and podcasts based on book material.
content:
Google's AI note-taking app, Gemini Notebook, can now pull information from the books you've purchased. The new "Expert Intelligence" feature allows you to bring titles from Google Play Books directly into Gemini Notebook, which means you can ask questions about the material, as well as generate plans, infographics, AI podcasts, and more based on their contents.

title: Google tells Android app developers to cool it on memory use, or else
summary: Google is policing memory-hungry Android apps through the Play Store, enforcing new memory-usage restrictions introduced with Android 17 to address the industry-wide RAM crisis.
content:
The memory crisis just won’t quit. | Image: Alex Castro / The Verge	

Google will start policing memory-hungry Android apps as a direct response to the RAM crisis. Spotted by TechCrunch, the company yesterday published a memo addressing the Play Store's role in enforcing new memory-usage restrictions. The post emphasizes the importance of meeting new memory usage limits for apps, in order "to help developers navigate industry-wide hardware constraints and Android's broader memory limits," it says. And failing to meet the new memory restrictions will come with consequences.
